title: Lamb Tagine with Exotic Spices
description: A classic French-inspired North African dish with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and a rich sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb with the sauce spooned over the top.
